Name: Eleazar, Son of Abinadab
Summary: Eleazar, son of Abinadab of Kirjath-jearim, was sanctified to keep the ark of the Lord while it rested in his father's house.
KeyStory: Eleazar guarded the ark for the twenty years it stayed at Kirjath-jearim.
LifeLesson: Guarding what God has entrusted to you, even in obscurity, is holy work.
